verdict.rationale: Replit's docs describe publishing apps to Replit's own 'production deployment' with a Replit-hosted URL, and even custom domains are just DNS overlays pointing to Replit's hosting (replit-docs-8, replit-docs-11, replit-docs-38) — there is no evidence of exporting code/containers or deploying to an external host (AWS, Vercel, etc.) or self-managed infrastructure.
